description: This is a Java unit test class for testing the behavior of JmsConnectionHandlingActor in the context of managing JMS connections in an AMQP messaging setup. It tests connection handling, failure scenarios, session recovery, and disconnects, using Mockito and Akka testkit.

classes.name: JmsConnectionHandlingActorTest
classes.description: Unit test class for JmsConnectionHandlingActor, verifies connection management, failure handling, and session recovery in an Akka actor environment.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the ActorSystem and connection object before all tests.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Shuts down the ActorSystem after all tests.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Mocks the createSession method for mockConnection before each test.

methods.name: handleFailureOnJmsConnect
methods.description: Tests actor behavior when starting the connection throws an exception.

methods.name: handleFailureWhenCreatingConsumers
methods.description: Tests actor behavior when creating consumers throws an exception.

methods.name: handleJmsConnect
methods.description: Verifies successful connection establishment and creation of consumers.

methods.name: handleRecoverSession
methods.description: Tests session recovery when an existing session is resumed.

methods.name: handleRecoverSessionFails
methods.description: Tests behavior when session recovery fails due to exception.

methods.name: handleJmsDisconnect
methods.description: Verifies proper handling of JMS disconnect and closing connection.

methods.name: handleFailureDuringJmsDisconnect
methods.description: Tests behavior when disconnecting the connection throws an exception.
